note: Bank access to Auxvasse Creek, in riparian forest and old fields east of Calwood. MDC's one primitive camping spot is on the grass beside a small gravel lot on County Road 139, with the creek behind a wooded strip. The road continues east across a low-water crossing; the lot is reached from the west without it. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map/GIS-designated primitive camping spot at the edge of the gravel lot (GIS 386 = pin, 17 m from lot 1948). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin kept; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; the map (© 5/08) has one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol beside its one Parking Lot on the gravel road; GIS 27 point 386. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN: stored 38.91276,-91.81175 = GIS 386, on mowed grass at the north edge of lot 1948 (38.91265,-91.81189, 17 m), a ~25 x 12 m gravel pull-off on County Road 139. Keep. ACCESS: the map's only 'Low Water Crossing' is ~400 m E of the lot, where the road crosses Auxvasse Creek; the approach from Calwood (Route JJ, County Roads 136 and 139) comes up the creek's west bank without crossing it (imagery checked at the bend 250 m SW). A 23-ft rig reaches the lot.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Auxvasse Creek is ~35-60 m N of the spot through a wooded bank; no open apron.
HORSES: none. CLUSTERS: one camping spot.
